summary: Agent failed to schedule the appointment, provided a misleading 'done' without details, did not confirm date/time, and repeatedly gave non-responses.

issues.description: No appointment options were offered or booked; the agent did not confirm provider, location, exact date, or time, and no confirmation was provided.
issues.recommendation: Follow scheduling SOP: verify identity, clarify 'next week' into exact calendar dates and time zone, present available slots, confirm provider/location, book in the system, read back details, and send/offer a confirmation number and instructions.

issues.description: Agent replied 'done' implying completion without any evidence of an actual booking or details.
issues.recommendation: Only confirm completion after a successful booking response from the scheduling system; include date, time, provider, location, and confirmation number in the confirmation statement.

issues.description: Implied an action (appointment scheduled) without performing or documenting it.
issues.recommendation: Gate confirmations on verifiable backend outcomes; if unavailable, state limitations and offer to transfer to a human scheduler.

issues.description: Multiple blank/non-responses and no acknowledgements to user prompts; conversation flow broke down.
issues.recommendation: Implement turn-taking and error-handling: acknowledge requests, ask clarifying questions, handle silence/timeouts with polite prompts, and escalate when the system cannot proceed.

issues.description: Failed to act on the clear intent to schedule an annual physical next week, including specific times offered by the patient.
issues.recommendation: Use intent handlers that trigger the scheduling flow upon detecting phrases like 'schedule annual physical' and proposed time windows; confirm exact dates and proceed to slot lookup.

issues.description: Did not verify patient identity (e.g., DOB, phone) before scheduling and did not confirm clinic/provider per standard operating procedures.
issues.recommendation: Require identity verification (full name + DOB or other clinic-approved identifiers) before accessing calendars; confirm clinic/provider preferences and document the appointment per policy.

issues.description: Misleading confirmation risk: patient may assume an appointment exists and miss needed care or be turned away.
issues.recommendation: Avoid provisional confirmations; clearly state when booking is pending or unsuccessful and provide alternatives (different times, waitlist, or transfer to staff).

issues.description: Did not offer alternative slots, waitlist, or preparation guidance for an annual physical (e.g., bring ID/insurance, medication list, possible fasting for labs).
issues.recommendation: After slot confirmation, provide pre-visit instructions, confirm contact preferences for reminders, explain cancellation/no-show policy, and offer waitlist/sooner options if desired.

issues.description: Repeated non-responses (silence) forced the patient to restate requests and questions.
issues.recommendation: Add fallback prompts after no response (e.g., 'I didn’t catch that—would Tuesday at 10 AM work?'); limit retries and then offer to transfer to a human.
